name: Survivor

abilities.name: Default kit
abilities.description: No deployable gear; vanilla baseline with no damage or survivability bonuses.

unlockAdvice: Free starter — replace as soon as you can afford Medic (10,000) or Marksman (15,000).
notes: Lowest damage and survivability; outgrown quickly on the Rooftop Map.

name: Medic

abilities.name: Stim Shot
abilities.description: Heal burst for teammates or self.

abilities.name: Mending Tower
abilities.description: Area heal over time.

abilities.name: Healing Station
abilities.description: Sustain platform for squad uptime.

bestFor: Players who want cheapest A-tier entry
unlockAdvice: Best budget first unlock for co-op (10,000 Credits). Dev-confirmed: Medic earns Credits from healing structures and players (2026-02-01 patch).
notes: Underwhelming solo — most value comes from keeping teammates alive.

name: Marksman

abilities.name: Frag Grenade
abilities.description: Burst damage for packs or elites.

abilities.name: Deadeye
abilities.description: Bullet pierce — scales with rifle kill volume.

abilities.name: Sonar Ping
abilities.description: Zombie detection — marks threats before they reach you.

bestFor: Best first unlock for solo DPS
Carry role in mixed public teams
counters: melee-range elites if caught without barricades
unlockAdvice: Recommended first paid unlock for most players (15,000). Pair with handgun → shotgun → rifle weapon path.
notes: Limited defensive tools — positioning matters on Rooftop stairwells.

name: Engineer

abilities.name: Flame Turret
abilities.description: Automated lane damage.

abilities.name: Auto Turret
abilities.description: Consistent DPS from a fixed position.

abilities.name: Steel Barricade
abilities.description: Blocks chokepoints — strong on Rooftop stairs.

bestFor: Holding a chokepoint in team play
counters: mobile fights when the team must rotate often
unlockAdvice: Buy only if you enjoy turret play; otherwise save for Tactician (75,000) as the structural-defense upgrade.
notes: Poor adaptability when repositioning — Tactician is the direct upgrade path.

name: Ninja

abilities.name: Cloak
abilities.description: Short invisibility window — zombies ignore you.

abilities.name: Blade Fury
abilities.description: Melee burst for clutch moments.

abilities.name: Shuriken
abilities.description: Ranged secondary for picks.

counters: late-wave elite stacks and open-field density on Rooftop
unlockAdvice: Skip as a first unlock — Marksman delivers better solo and team value for 10,000 fewer Credits.
notes: Pro Game Guides rates Ninja D-tier; close-range kit falls off mid-to-late waves.

name: Demolitionist

abilities.name: Stim Shot
abilities.description: Self sustain between bomb cycles.

abilities.name: Shockwave Bomb
abilities.description: Knockback + stun for packed zombies.

abilities.name: Molotov
abilities.description: Persistent fire patch — area DOT.

unlockAdvice: Mid-progression pick for teams that need pack disruption; not required before Tactician unless you love AoE kits.
notes: Damage profile leans on gear more than raw weapon DPS — shotgun stays viable late.

name: Tactician

abilities.name: Vanguard Turret
abilities.description: Auto-targets elite zombies.

abilities.name: Spikes
abilities.description: Passive chip damage on chokepoints.

abilities.name: Steel Barricade
abilities.description: Extended fortification durability.

counters: frequent full-team repositioning without setup time
unlockAdvice: Top A-tier structural pick — aim for this after Marksman if your squad holds lanes. Strong on Rooftop Map since 2026-04-18.
notes: Setup-heavy; weaker when the lobby keeps rotating across the arena.

name: Bastion

abilities.name: Bunker
abilities.description: Squad-wide invincibility bubble + HP regen + damage boost — whole team benefits.

abilities.name: Laser Turret
abilities.description: Auto-tracks and fires red lasers at range.

abilities.name: Drone
abilities.description: Auto-shoots and soaks damage; stackable drone swarm.

bestFor: Keeping full 25-player lobbies alive in clutch waves
unlockAdvice: Unlock if your team prioritizes squad survival over solo scaling; save Necromancer grind unless leaderboard-focused.
notes: Media-reported — tier contested (PGG S-tier vs Destructoid A-tier). Likely added ~May 2026; dev-previewed drone gear 2026-05-03.

name: Necromancer

abilities.name: Soul Harvester
abilities.description: Consume defeated zombies for resources.

abilities.name: Raise Undead
abilities.description: Zombie minions fight for you — kills credit the player (patched 2026-02-01).

abilities.name: Death Nova
abilities.description: Detonate minions for massive area damage in funnels.

counters: early waves before minion economy online
unlockAdvice: Endgame unlock — farm after Marksman → Tactician fundamentals. May 8, 2026 buff: higher minion walkspeed and damage (exact values undisclosed).
notes: Only S-tier class; cost updated to 250,000 in May 2026 sources (older guides cite 200,000). Requires active kit management.
